name: Steel of West Virginia Melt Shop
old_description: The Steel of West Virginia family of companies aims to provide our customers with industry leading products by maintaining focus of our ethics and standards. In fact, we have embraced Steel Dynamics, Inc.'s Six Pillars of Success to demonstrate our commitments.
about:
Steel of West Virginia operates a melt shop and fabrication facility in Huntington, West Virginia. The business is part of Steel Dynamics, Inc., a national steel producer, and operates under the SDI family of companies. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The company produces steel products and provides fabrication services for a range of heavy-industry sectors. Its product lines include structural shapes such as merchant beams and channels, guardrail components, and parts for truck trailers, industrial trucks, rail and track systems, off-highway equipment, and solar installations. The facility combines melting and fabrication capabilities, though specific equipment lists, floor space, headcount, and annual tonnage are not published.

Customers span transportation, infrastructure, energy, and industrial equipment markets. Concrete examples from the company’s own site list truck trailer manufacturers, industrial truck builders, rail and track contractors, guardrail suppliers, off-highway equipment makers, and solar project developers as target industries.

Steel of West Virginia states that it differentiates itself by adhering to Steel Dynamics’ Six Pillars of Success, emphasizing ethics, standards, and a commitment to industry-leading products.
